Veterans Benefits: Texas has no state income tax, so military retirement pay is untaxed at the state level. Disabled veterans receive a rating-scaled residence-homestead exemption, and a 100% service-connected or individually unemployable veteran receives a total homestead property-tax exemption, with surviving-spouse continuation.

Description: San Angelo is an affordable West Texas city built around Goodfellow Air Force Base (17th Training Wing, intelligence and DoD firefighter training) and Angelo State University. It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, Texas's no-income-tax treatment of military retirement pay, low housing costs, a Concho River walk, and the lowest crime rate in this batch. Tradeoffs include hot semi-arid summers and no local Costco.
